submitted.rationale: EQE rose steadily as Sb went down: 0.0099% at Sb 0.49, 0.018% at 0.62, 0.052% at 0.27, then peaked at 0.135% at Sb 0.164 (index 2) and fell to 0.107% at 0.1225. The optimum is therefore on the Fe-rich end, near Sb ≈ 0.14–0.16. Index 2 has the highest EQE I measured.

rejected.reason: Measured 0.107%, lower than index 2; EQE drops again at the lowest Sb fraction.
Measured 0.0099%. EQE is low near the FeSbO4 stoichiometry.
